# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server: linkTo's second round (enableLinkTo, a
# linked misc_mg42, a tag parent's model change, items unlinked in mid-air).
# map mp_carentan, gametype dm (served as probe_linkto2), one client joined allies.
# Two shells, the gsc probe first, then the client about 8 s later:
#   COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PORT=29581 PROBE_SECS=75 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_linkto2 mp_carentan
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:29581 --probe-team allies --probe-secs 64
# probe_linkto2.gsc moves the bombzone_A trigger_multiple (entity 176) onto the
# player by an origin write, then enableLinkTo's and links it to a
# script_origin that carries it there and back; links the misc_mg42 297 to a
# script_origin and lifts and turns it; links k1 (on "bip01 head") and k0 (no
# tag) to a script_model and changes its model four times; links an item the
# frame it spawns in mid-air and one that has landed, lifts both and unlinks
# them; and ends on enableLinkTo on a script_origin, whose fatal is the last
# measurement. docs/research/cod11-movers.md, section 16, is what it measured.
# This file is the server half, games_mp.log's PROBE lines (the console's error
# block as PROBE_ERR):
#   PROBE g <phase> <time> <origin> <angles>          per server frame
#   PROBE m <phase> <time> <m origin> <k1 origin> <k1 angles> <k0 origin>
#   PROBE n t <time> <toucher>                        every "trigger" notify
# The client sent about three cmds a server frame, so a frame the player
# touched the trigger on carries up to three n lines.
PROBE player 0 xmodel/playerbody_american_airborne
